 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The lattice separators contain no interior/background (9) cells.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 9 not in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h))]

    # The ordinary separator color is the most frequent non-9 color.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 9)
    base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    marked = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)
              if grid[r][c] != base]
    if not marked:
        return []
    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)

    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        line = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            color = corners[0]
            line.append(color if color != base and all(v == color for v in corners) else 9)
        out.append(line)
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
